title: An original model for multi-target learning of logical rules for knowledge graph reasoning
reasoning: The paper focuses on knowledge graph reasoning and proposes a new model (MPLR) along with novel indicators. It evaluates its model against state-of-the-art methods on several benchmark datasets (FB15K-237, WN18, UMLS, Kinship, Family). There is no content discussing religion, faith, spiritual traditions, morals, or ethics as a subject of study or benchmarking component.
